The antiviral drug used for treating influenza, including H1N1, is:
questions.why: Oseltamivir is a neuraminidase inhibitor used for influenza A and B, best within 48 hours of onset.

questions.why: The three factors predisposing to thrombosis.

questions.q: The normal fasting blood glucose in adults is about:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. 100–125 mg/dL is impaired fasting glucose.

questions.q: The hormone that raises blood sugar during fasting and is secreted by the alpha cells of the pancreas is:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. It promotes glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis.

questions.q: Which miasm has the itch eruption as its primary manifestation?
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Psora is the chronic miasm whose primary outward sign is the itch (scabies-like) eruption.

questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Oedema is the hallmark of kwashiorkor.
